title: Grade Book Statistics
description:
```
Enter scores (-1 to finish): 88 92 75 64 99 81 -1
Count: 6   Mean: 83.17   Median: 84.5   Std dev: 11.6
Min: 64    Max: 99       Range: 35
Histogram:
 60-69 | *
 70-79 | *
 80-89 | **
 90-99 | **
```
hints: After `std::sort`, the median of an odd count is the middle element; of an even count, the average of the two middle ones: `(v[n / 2 - 1] + v[n / 2]) / 2.0`.

Standard deviation: the square root of the average squared distance from the mean. `std::accumulate(v.begin(), v.end(), 0.0, [mean](double total, int x) { return total + (x - mean) * (x - mean); })` gives the sum of squares.
The bucket of a score is `score / 10` (so 64 goes in bucket 6). `++buckets[score / 10]` for each score, with 100 put in bucket 9.
